title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.25898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. translated_title: 医学大语言模型中的可验证逻辑：智能体临床推理优化与神经符号接地的批判性综述
translated_abstract: 临床大语言模型通常以最终答案是否正确作为评判标准。然而，模型可能通过无效的推理得出流畅、看似合理的输出，而静态基准测试无法检测到这种情况；自信的幻觉、因果无效的推理以及虚假的人口统计学捷径都可能通过传统评估。本批判性综述依次涵盖四种范式：临床幻觉如何产生以及为什么静态指标会漏检它；智能体幻觉级联——即多智能体和工具增强系统会传播并放大早期推理错误；过程奖励建模作为步骤级监督；以及神经符号接地——形式逻辑引擎、本体推理机和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证的约束。在其编码的知识范围内，具有符号否决层的系统能够提供相对于其编码知识成立的保证，并在安全性指标上报告了显著的提升。
tldr: 这篇综述指出临床大语言模型的最终答案正确并不代表推理有效，并系统评述了幻觉成因、智能体幻觉级联、过程奖励建模与神经符号接地四种范式，其中带符号否决层的系统能在其编码知识范围内提供可验证的安全保证。
en_tdlr: This critical review argues that fluent final answers from clinical LLMs can mask invalid reasoning, examining four paradigms—clinical hallucination, agentic hallucination cascades, process reward modeling, and neuro-symbolic grounding—where symbolic veto layers provide verifiable guarantees within their encoded knowledge domains.
